def check_divisibility(n1, n2):
    '''
    Helper function to check if the first number (n1) is divisible by the second number (n2).
    Returns True if n1 is divisible by n2, False otherwise.
    '''
    if n1 % n2 == 0:
        return True
    else:
        return False
